title: EXP-030 — Additional Confidence Replay: Button Name/Type Recovery Across Ordinary Close/Reopen
objective: Perform an additional confidence replay of the canonical EXP-027 procedure, already independently replay-verified by accepted EXP-027-R2 for exact Button Name and visible property-grid Type-label recovery across User-scope ordinary Save > Form-tab close > same-Designer recent-forms reopen. This tests no new Mongoose capability. On one new User-scoped classic BuildFromScratch Form `FX_ButtonTypeRecoveryLab01`, place exactly one native Toolbox Button, assign only Name=`FX_ButtonTypeRecovery01`, and record its exact visible property-grid Type label before Save. Perform exactly one ordinary Designer Save, verify clean state with Name/Type unchanged, close the target Form exactly once, and reopen it exactly once through the same Designer's Form-menu recent-forms path. Verify the same scoped Form recovers the recorded Name and exact Type label. Success is an accepted additional confirming replay of the existing replay_verified finding, not a separate newly observed capability or new promotion of Type recovery. Claims remain UI-level recovery across this bounded workflow only, without database durability, cache eviction, serialization, Caption persistence, or behavior of other component types/properties.

acceptance_checks.description: Before mutation, evidence records a fresh worker/session identity distinct from EXP-027's ses_eea6d6124ffes94Z5Ncy8SwXYM and EXP-027-R2's ses_eea48b294ffewiRJGXFlT7uTdC, preserves inherited state untouched, proves a usable live workflow and editing scope User, shows a settled rendered Select Form positive-control row corresponding to an exact known-existing Name with Case Sensitive unchecked, and proves zero case-insensitive Name matches for `FX_ButtonTypeRecoveryLab01`. Worker freshness does not require browser restart or Designer replacement. If freshness or the positive control is not proven within the bounded inspection, or the target already exists, stop blocked without mutation.

Evidence proves exactly one User-scoped classic BuildFromScratch Form `FX_ButtonTypeRecoveryLab01` was created through the verified fresh-dialog procedure with Save Template visibly unchecked. Form/version-specific evidence proves the loaded identity Name=`FX_ButtonTypeRecoveryLab01`, ScopeType=User, ScopeName=<current user>; the current Designer editing-scope/status bar alone is insufficient. If the exact loaded version cannot be established, this check does not pass.
Before component placement, evidence proves the target Form is clean and untouched and records the rendered canvas/component state without claiming complete component cardinality.

Exactly one native Toolbox Button creation operation is evidenced. Only Name is assigned, to exactly `FX_ButtonTypeRecovery01`. Before Save, authoritative visible property-grid/accessibility evidence records Name=`FX_ButtonTypeRecovery01` and the exact visible Type label, with no unrelated component-property mutation.
Exactly one ordinary Designer Save is evidenced; afterward the target is clean and the Button still reports Name=`FX_ButtonTypeRecovery01` and the identical Type label recorded in AC-4.

Exactly one ordinary Form-tab close is evidenced with the target tab removed, no unsaved-change or unexpected prompt, and the same Designer retained; the target is then reopened exactly once through that Designer's Form-menu recent-forms entry, not by direct URL or Select Form.

After reopen, Form/version-specific evidence proves exact Name=`FX_ButtonTypeRecoveryLab01`, ScopeType=User, and ScopeName matching the pre-close Form version; the current Designer editing-scope/status bar alone is insufficient. Evidence also proves clean state, recovered component Name=`FX_ButtonTypeRecovery01`, and visible Type exactly equal to the AC-4 pre-close value. If the exact reopened version cannot be established, this check does not pass.

Final read-only audit shows exactly one visible case-insensitive matching row for `FX_ButtonTypeRecoveryLab01` in the inspected Select Form result, without implying database uniqueness. Reconcile exactly one Form creation, one Button placement, one Name assignment, one ordinary Save, one close, one recent-forms reopen, and zero explicit global-Form-object unloads, and prove repository changes are confined to the EXP-030 record plus `evidence/EXP-030/`. If every acceptance check passes, record success as an accepted additional confirming replay of the existing EXP-027/EXP-027-R2 replay_verified finding. Do not create a separate observed Type-label capability awaiting replay or claim a new promotion to replay_verified. If any prerequisite or lifecycle check fails, preserve the partial evidence without confirming this replication or changing the prior accepted finding.
